component.name: Voidstrap
component.summary: Customize and launch Roblox through Sober on Linux

description.p: Voidstrap is an open source Roblox bootstrapper for Linux that installs and launches Roblox through Sober.
It brings FastFlags, performance and graphics controls, mods, themes, account tools, server tools, Discord Rich Presence, and desktop integrations together in one customizable app.
